parts.label: (i)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
$\overline{AB} = +/- \begin{pmatrix} -18 \\ 9 \\ -18 \end{pmatrix}, \quad \overline{BC} = +/- \begin{pmatrix} 12 \\ -6 \\ 12 \end{pmatrix},$ B1 B1 (Allow $\mathbf{i}$, $\mathbf{j}$, $\mathbf{k}$ form throughout.)
$|\overline{AB}| = 27,$ B1 FT (FT on $their$ $\overline{AB}$, $their$ $\overline{OD}$.)
$|\overline{BC}| = 18$ B1 FT (FT on $their$ $\overline{AB}$, $their$ $\overline{OD}$.)
$|\overline{CD}| = \left(\frac{18}{27}\right) \times 18 \quad \text{OR} \quad \left(\frac{18}{27}\right)^{2} \times 27 = 12$ B1

parts.label: (ii)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
$\overline{CD} = (\pm) their \frac{18}{27} \times their \; \overline{BC}$ SOI M1 (Expect $(\pm) \begin{pmatrix} 8 \\ -4 \\ 8 \end{pmatrix}$.)
$\overline{OD} = \begin{pmatrix} 2 \\ -3 \\ -1 \end{pmatrix} (\pm) their \frac{18}{27} \begin{pmatrix} 12 \\ -6 \\ 12 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} 10 \\ -7 \\ 7 \end{pmatrix}, \begin{pmatrix} -6 \\ 1 \\ -9 \end{pmatrix}$ M1 A1 A1 (Other methods possible for $\overline{OD}$, e.g. $\overline{OB} + \frac{5}{2} \overline{CD}$, $\overline{OB} + \frac{1}{2} \overline{CD}$ (One soln M2A1, 2nd soln A1) OR $\overline{OB} + \frac{5}{3} \overline{BC}$, $\overline{OB} + \frac{1}{3} \overline{BC}$ (One soln M2A1, 2nd soln A1))
